title: Note piemontesi
hero_alt: Larches turned orange along a mountain stream in Valle Argentera
cover_alt: The pyramid of Monviso behind bare branches at sunset
lede: Notes from Piedmont, through the seasons: the hill above Turin, the gardens and woods of the Savoy kings, a valley of golden larches and the high plateau of the Gran Paradiso.
meta_description: Piedmont through the seasons: the Maddalena hill above Turin, Venaria Reale in blossom, the La Mandria park, the larches of Valle Argentera and the Nivolet plateau.

1.title: La Maddalena
1.intro: The highest point of the hill that rises behind Turin. From up here the city is a grid in the haze, the Alps run along the whole horizon and, on clear evenings, Monviso stands alone to the south-west.

2.title: Venaria Reale
2.intro: The gardens of the Savoy royal residence at the end of March, when the orchards burst into pink and white and the mountains behind still wear their snow.

3.title: La Mandria
3.intro: Once the hunting estate of the Savoy kings, now a walled park on the edge of the city: meadows, old oaks and a river, with deer and herons for anyone willing to wait.

4.title: Valle Argentera
4.intro: A side valley high above Sauze di Cesana, at the moment the larches turn. The first snow on the ground, the stream running clear over the rocks and the whole slope on fire.

5.title: Gran Paradiso
5.intro: The Nivolet plateau, on the edge of Italy's oldest national park: high pastures, a stream winding across the meadow and peaks of grey and red rock.
